CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  CORONAVRIUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the
State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer at Home Order,
the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee will not be physically open to the public and
will take place via video conference.
To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:
https://zoom.us/j/93224932815?pwd=OGdaZ29Rc0pVTmw0R09JWUJ5NXY3QT09 with Meeting ID: 932 2493
2815 and Passcode: 871793.

Zoom Meeting direct link:
https://zoom.us/j/93224932815?pwd=OGdaZ29Rc0pVTmw0R09JWUJ5NXY3QT09

For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at
kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your
name. You should then join into the meeting using Meeting ID: 932 2493 2815, and Passcode:
871793, or US Toll-free, 833 548 0282 US Toll-free, 877 853 5257 US Toll-free, 888 475 4499 US
Toll-free 10 minutes prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will announce to you when it is your time
to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the President.
As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no
later than 5:00 P.M. on May 19, 2021 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the
meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per
individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but
before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a
part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
e-mail or call Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference meetings, all participants are
encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

minutes_text:
Unofficial until adopted by the  July 21, 2021
City Arts and Cultural Events Committee  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  Wednesday, June 16, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee was called to order at 7:02
P.M. on Wednesday, June 16, 2021, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street Alhambra, via
Video Conference Zoom.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: Canseco-Chan, Sanchez, and Jimenez.
Committee Members Absent: None.
Also attending: Director Michael Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, and Clerical Assistant
II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES FROM THE MAY 19, 2021 C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion by Vice President Sanchez and a second from committee member Jimenez, the
minutes of May 19, 2021, City Arts and Cultural Events Committee meeting were unanimously
approved as written.

ALHAMBRA ART ALLEY PROJECT
President Canseco-Chan discussed how integral community feedback is for the design process of
the Alhambra Art Alley. He recommends a survey and/or poll to be made available through the
city’s official website and social media platforms to continue engagement and gather information
on the type of art residents are interested in for their community. Committee member Jimenez
said she could have a draft survey available by next month’s City Arts and Cultural Events
meeting. Vice President Sanchez expressed that it would be helpful to have additional committee
members present and asked if staff knew when City Council would appoint other City Arts and
Cultural Events committee members. Director Macias responded that he would speak with City
Manager to get an update about when City Council plans to appoint additional members to the
group.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton shared an artist biography, art samples, and application from Mr. Rey
Sepulveda to the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. With a motion from Vice President
Sanchez and a second by committee member Jimenez, Mr. Rey Sepulveda’s exhibition titled
Cultivarte and Friends was approved to be on display at the Alhambra City Hall Gallery month
of October 2021. In addition, vice President Sanchez expressed that it could be beneficial to gift
Alhambra City Hall Gallery visitors a 10% off voucher for local restaurants and businesses
through a collaboration with the Chamber of Commerce and Alhambra Downtown Business
Association.
 PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Vice President Sanchez shared a public art installation called “Weaving Hope” in Highland Park
by Yeu Q. Nguyen to the committee. Deputy Director Houghton said it would be a great idea
that could work for the upcoming Autumn Fest event in October 2021 at Alhambra Park. She
encouraged Vice President Sanchez to contact the artist to inquire about dimensions, pricing,
materials, and availability.

Vice President Sanchez asked the staff if Alhambra has utilized L.A. County’s program for free
outdoor summer concerts with their roster of local musicians and artists. Deputy Director
Houghton replied that the Alhambra hosts free movies and concerts in the park every summer.
Director Macias added that the city has worked with the L.A. County in the past and would be
open to learning more about their funding for possible upcoming events or the following summer
concert series.

ADJOURNMENT
President Canseco-Chan moved to adjourn June 16, 2021, City Arts and Cultural Events
Committee Meeting. Seconded by Vice President Sanchez, the meeting was adjourned at 7:46
P.M.
